description:
On Aug. 12, 2026, a total solar eclipse will be visible in parts of Greenland, Iceland, northern Russia, the Atlantic Ocean, Spain, and a small corner of Portugal.

Get tips from our photography experts on how to capture the unforgettable moment with a photo!

Learn more about the 2026 total solar eclipse: https://go.nasa.gov/3RUlbr9

Credit: NASA
title: How to Photograph a Total Solar Eclipse
